public_rationale: OpenAI's launch documentation identifies spontaneous appearances as a model weakness, especially in crowded scenes. That supports the ordinary reading of not a one-off: a recurring failure mode. It does not establish that most videos fail. Independent evidence of successful consistency in selected clips limits a stronger reading, so the interpretation is explicitly flagged.
limitations: Support rests on contemporaneous developer documentation rather than a representative independent audit.
General is interpreted as recurring, not universal or predominant.
The geometric-consistency study measures a related but different capability.
